items.q: The dietary prescription for edema is salt restriction below 2 g/day with protein at:
items.exp: Salt restriction <2 g/day; protein 1 g/kg/day; albumin, FFP. (Book p759)

items.q: Diuretics are avoided in nephrotic edema; they are indicated only when:
opts: IVC is non-collapsible on USG, because diuretics precipitate pre-renal AKI
items.exp: Diuretics avoided; indicated only if IVC is non-collapsible in USG; reason: precipitates pre-renal AKI. (Book p759)

items.q: Daily monitoring of the nephrotic child includes weight, urine routine examination and:
items.exp: Daily monitoring: weight; urine routine examination; urine protein creatinine ratio. (Book p759)
